content.citation: Companies (Amendment) Act, 2017, Act 1 of 2018, ss. 27–28; brought into force for these amendments on 9 February 2018
content.note: Official India Code Gazette PDF for amendments inserting the EGM place proviso in Companies Act section 100 and replacing section 101(1)'s shorter-notice consent proviso. Read with the principal Act; this does not verify every applicable meeting rule or company-specific exemption.
